valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 non-GAAP diluted EPS excluding acquired-IPR&D charges, viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), times a justified P/E. USD listing, no ADR conversion. Anchor: FY2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance $2.77-$2.82 (raised Oct 29 2026), which includes one-time charges of $3.62 (Cidara), $2.31 (Terns) and $0.12 (SciBrunch) per share, i.e. about $6.05 in total; adding these back gives about $8.85 on sales of $66.8-$67.3B and about 2.48B diluted shares. FY2027 EPS is my own assumption (no company 2027 guidance; no sourced consensus). It assumes mid-single-digit sales growth from Keytruda/Qlex, Gardasil and new launches, flat margins, and no new large IPR&D charge; a future business-development charge would cut reported EPS.

bear.driver: Keytruda 2028 loss of exclusivity and pricing/Gardasil pressure drive investors to a trough multiple; underlying growth stalls and opex rises.

base.driver: Underlying EPS grows about 2% from the roughly $8.85 FY2026 add-back level as Keytruda Qlex conversion, launches and Gardasil offset Q3 purchase-timing reversal; multiple stays below the large-cap pharma premium because of the 2028 Keytruda cliff.

bull.driver: Subcutaneous Keytruda conversion protects the franchise, pipeline (sac-TMT, Enflonsia, Winrevair) offsets the 2028 cliff, and margins expand on cost savings.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of $9.00 the $147.76 close implies 16.4x; the equal-weight average of the seven named pre-close targets (about $156) implies 17.3x on $9.00, or about $10.05 EPS at 15.5x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $9.00 (about 6.1 pp of the close).
valuation.watch_metric: Keytruda plus Keytruda Qlex sales (Q3 2026 $8.6B, Qlex $830M) and the Qlex share of conversion, plus 2027 non-GAAP EPS guidance including any IPR&D charges.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and FY2026 results with initial 2027 guidance, expected around early February 2027 (date not confirmed).

analyst_notes: Seven named analysts (Goldman, Cantor, Scotiabank, RBC, DZ Bank, Leerink, Freedom Capital) issued calls from Nov 2-13 2026, all after the Oct 29 earnings release; three Buys and four Holds with targets of $140-$180. Goldman raised $155 to $165, Leerink $161 to $162 and Freedom $125 to $140, with no cuts. The $156 average target is about 12% above my base of $139.5, equal to roughly $1.05 of FY2027 EPS at 15.5x or one turn of multiple. A Barclays Buy at $180 dated Nov 16 falls after the reference close and is excluded. Horizons are undocumented, so no target enters the weighted average, and all calls come from a single aggregator table.
